cues: Because every oxygen atom released comes from water, not from carbon dioxide.
In nineteen forty-one, Ruben and Kamen gave the alga Chlorella water labelled with heavy oxygen, and the heavy oxygen came out in the gas.
Twelve water molecules carry exactly the twelve oxygen atoms of six oxygen molecules.
